problem: The vector $a$ has magnitude $7$, the vector $b$ has magnitude $2$, the angle between $a$ and $b$ is ${135}^{∘}$ and $n$ is the unit vector that points in the direction of $a\times b.$ Find $a\times b$ in terms of $n.$

feedback.problem: The vector $a$ has magnitude $2$, the vector $b$ has magnitude $9$, the angle between $a$ and $b$ is ${45}^{∘}$ and $n$ is the unit vector that points in the direction of $a\times b.$ Find $a\times b$ in terms of $n.$
feedback.worked_solution:
We use the formula for the cross product and obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}a\times b & =|a|\cdot |b|\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡\theta \cdot n \\  & =2\cdot 9\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{45}^{∘}\cdot n \\  & =18\cdot \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cdot n \\  & =9\sqrt{2}n.\end{aligned}
$$
